entry_points.summary: Stable <basename>-<8hex> repo id from git-common-dir SHA-256; identical across worktrees
Non-littering writability probe; creates and removes temp tree without side effects
Atomic tmpfile+rename anchor creation; validates on existing anchor; no-ops on tier-1
5-tier base resolver (Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR > XDG_STATE_HOME > HOME/.local/state > git-common-dir > pwd) with anchor enforcement
Validates and returns Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR or empty; exits on non-absolute
Alias for z_harness_base; used in diagnostics and stats
Returns <base>/active-plans; propagates z_harness_base failures
Returns <base>/followups; propagates z_harness_base failures
<base>/plans/<slug> with Z_HARNESS_PLANS_DIR override; enforces absolute constraint when Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR also set
Returns z-harness/<slug> (primary legacy flat path)
Returns z-harness/plans/<slug> (in-repo plans/ legacy path)
Dual-read: new path first, then z-harness/plans/<slug>, then z-harness/<slug>; one-time deprecation warning per parent PID
Deduplicated slugs from new layout (<base>/plans/) and legacy flat (<base>/) under resolved base
Python3 realpath resolution; exits on unresolvable path; prevents self-migration false-negative
Queries active-plan registry for status:running; exits on liveness query failure
Emits plan_migrated event via log-event.sh if available and Z_HARNESS_RUN_ID is set
copy -> byte-verify -> mtime-verify -> rm; refuse-on-conflict; idempotent when source absent
Dedup-append metrics.jsonl into existing target; idempotent across crash/re-run
Migrates one slug from both legacy sources to <base>/plans/<slug>
Full migration: all plan slugs, archive, metrics, followups, flat TASKS.md, empty-dir cleanup

invariants: Path construction MUST go through plan-path.sh helpers (base_dir/plan_dir/active_plans_dir/followups_dir/all_plan_slugs/resolve_plan_path) — inline z-harness/ literals are a DRY violation.
z_harness_base() writes/validates <git-common-dir>/.z-harness-base anchor on tiers 2-5; anchor mismatch is hard FATAL. Tier-1 Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR neither reads nor writes the anchor.
Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR and Z_HARNESS_PLANS_DIR must both be absolute paths when both are set; non-absolute values cause exit 1.
External base is DEFAULT (Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT unset == 1); set to 0 or Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR=$(pwd)/z-harness to revert to in-repo.
Helpers that compose on z_harness_base() propagate its failure and refuse to build paths on an empty base.

safe_move is always copy -> verify(byte-equal AND source mtime unchanged) -> rm; source removed only after verify; refuse-on-conflict (never overwrite non-empty target, except metrics.jsonl which is dedup-merged).
migrate-plan-layout.sh refuses a real move while any active-plan registry record is status:running (live-run barrier, invariant 8); --dry-run warns but still previews.
metrics.jsonl migration is dedup-append (idempotent across crash/re-run); followups/ migration is opt-in (--with-followups) to avoid stranding in-flight locks.
base_resolved telemetry emitted at most once per process (per-PID stamp) and only when Z_HARNESS_RUN_ID is set and _Z_HARNESS_RESOLVING_BASE is not set.
gotchas: Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR must be absolute; relative value causes immediate exit 1.
When both Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR and Z_HARNESS_PLANS_DIR are set, Z_HARNESS_PLANS_DIR must also be absolute or plan_dir() exits 1.
Tier-1 Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR bypasses anchor entirely — existing dev machine anchor is never touched by CI/benchmark overrides.
_z_harness_probe_writable is non-littering: it creates and removes the probe dir tree without leaving stray directories.
all_plan_slugs excludes infrastructure names: plans, archive, adhoc, followups, improvements, active-plans, metrics.jsonl, bench.
--slug NAME is required to migrate a flat z-harness/TASKS.md; without it the file is skipped with a warning.
log-event.sh sources plan-path.sh; source-loop guard (_Z_HARNESS_RESOLVING_BASE=1) prevents recursive z_harness_base() -> log-event.sh -> z_harness_base() chain.
canonicalize_path in migrate-plan-layout.sh exits loudly on unresolvable paths to prevent symlink asymmetry masking source==target self-migration.
